profile.headline: Senior Backend Engineer | PHP & Symfony | Node.js & TypeScript | APIs, Payments, Microservices & Async Processing
profile.summary:
Senior Backend Engineer with 10+ years of experience designing, building, and operating production-grade systems across startups and large platforms.

Specialized in Node.js and TypeScript backend architectures, API-driven systems, asynchronous processing, and microservices, with a strong background in PHP-based platforms.

I’ve led and contributed to backend initiatives involving payment platforms, subscription systems, background workers, messaging queues, and real-time communication, always with a focus on reliability, performance, and maintainability.

Throughout my career, I’ve worked closely with product, frontend, and infrastructure teams to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions, often refactoring legacy systems and improving operational stability in high-impact environments.

I enjoy working on complex backend problems end-to-end, making pragmatic architectural decisions, and continuously improving system quality as products evolve and scale.

Feel free to reach out if you’d like to connect or exchange perspectives on backend architecture, distributed systems, or building reliable software at scale.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
- Designed and implemented subscription and recurring billing workflows for a multi-country marketplace, handling plan lifecycle, payment retries, failures, and operational edge cases.
- Stabilized and improved payment platform integrations that were causing transaction failures, increasing successful transactions by ~30% and improving overall reliability of the payment flow.
- Refactored memory-intensive PHP background jobs that were crashing under high load, significantly improving performance, stability, and long-term maintainability of critical batch processes.
- Contributed to backend architecture decisions around asynchronous processing, messaging, and system scalability in a high-traffic production environment.
positions.insights: Skills: Node.js · Integraciones con terceros · RabbitMQ · Framework Symfony · MySQL · Docker

positions.title: Web Platform Modernization Consultant
positions.description:
• Modernized the company’s public-facing website by migrating the legacy PHP implementation to Next.js, creating a more maintainable foundation for future updates.
• Reorganized the website into reusable components and improved the page structure, performance, and consistency of the customer-facing experience.
• Migrated the deployment workflow to Vercel, simplifying releases and reducing infrastructure costs and ongoing maintenance requirements.

positions.title: Lead Backend Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed the backend domain for loan origination, repayment schedules, payment allocation, account balances, and role-based access.
• Migrated historical borrower, loan, and payment data from a legacy application into a NestJS/MySQL platform, implementing validation and reconciliation controls to protect financial data integrity.
• Integrated Stripe and Auth0 and containerized the application to provide consistent development and deployment environments.
positions.insights: Skills: NestJS · MySQL · Docker · Stripe · Auth0

positions.title: Full-stack Developer
positions.description:
- Led backend architecture for Node.js microservices in a startup environment, driving scalability improvements and evolving the system beyond its initial monolithic design.
- Designed and implemented real-time, event-driven synchronization between Google Sheets and backend services using Node.js and Google Apps Script, eliminating data inconsistencies and manual reconciliation.
- Built asynchronous processing pipelines using Redis queues and real-time status updates via Socket.io, enabling reliable background execution and visibility into long-running operations.
- Delivered an automated document generation system using Node.js and React, reducing manual Word template creation time by ~80% and improving operational efficiency.
positions.insights: Skills: Redis · React.js · Microservicios · Node.js · Socket.io · Express.js · MongoDB · TypeScript · Laravel · API de Google · NestJS · Git · Docker

positions.title: Software Development Team Lead
positions.description:
- Led the design and development of a centralized ERP-style backend platform that consolidated administrative and financial data from offices across multiple cities, significantly reducing processing times and operational friction.
- Built backend systems to ingest and process large volumes of admission exam data for ~35,000 students, reducing result review time from weeks to less than a day through automated data ingestion workflows.
- Led and mentored a development team, introducing agile practices and technical standards that more than doubled on-time project delivery while improving overall solution quality.
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · Node.js · Capacidad de análisis · PHP · Gestión de proyectos · PostgreSQL · Gestión de servicios de TI · MongoDB · Sass · jQuery · Laravel · Doctrine · Procesos de negocio

positions.title: Backend Engineer
positions.description:
• Built a PHP/MySQL platform that centralized laboratory results across multiple locations and provided secure online access for patients.
• Designed the data model and workflows for patient records, laboratory results, branch operations, and controlled access to sensitive healthcare information.
• Developed the company’s public website and connected it with the laboratory results platform, allowing patients to access published results online.

positions.title: Junior Web Developer
positions.description:
• Contributed to ASP.NET MVC web applications that transformed operational data into statistical reports used to support management decision-making.
• Developed cross-platform mobile applications with Apache Cordova for collecting harvest and production data directly from field operations, supporting faster and more consistent data consolidation.
• Collaborated with operational teams to translate field data-collection requirements into practical web and mobile workflows.
positions.insights: Skills: Microsoft SQL Server · JavaScript · HTML · CSS · ASP.NET MVC · Apache Cordova · Highcharts

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Developed an institutional budgeting platform that centralized financial data from departments across multiple cities, reducing the budget preparation process from months to weeks.
• Automated previously manual consolidation workflows, improving the accuracy, consistency, and availability of information used during institutional budget preparation.
• Built a centralized reservation platform for rooms, auditoriums, and shared facilities across multiple university campuses, improving availability visibility and response times for reservation requests.
• Collaborated with administrative departments to analyze existing processes, define system requirements, and deliver applications aligned with operational needs.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · C# · Capacidad de análisis · PHP · PostgreSQL · HTML · jQuery · CSS · MySQL · Trabajo en equipo
